dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: Frankly, I was terrified when the water level started rising! But I didn't even have time to react before Archenoul rushed over and took me away.

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: Once everything settled down, I thanked her three times, just like grandpa taught me!

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: I guess only the strong can become a hero like Archenoul, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Cava
dialogues.text: I have to work hard! I'll run! I'll jump! And I'll swim!
